rubric_items.reason: All 19 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-19) are traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed REQs.
Most stories have one outcome. S-5 groups booking rules, new ID and the untouched original. S-3 groups prefill, editability and the limit. Both are still small.

ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly discriminating. The time-zone AC uses a real local/UTC date split. Gaps: no AC for the APT-2 free-slot rule, only one side of the 300-char limit is tested, and S-6 ACs say 'behaves as today'.
Values come from the intent or ticket: 300 chars, Asia/Kolkata, the button texts and the APT rule ids. The UTC+05:30 instant is worked out inline in the AC.
Terms are clear and consistent with the glossary. Minor awkward wording in S-2 AC2 ('the local side of midnight').

findings.text: REQ-12 names three unchanged booking rules (APT-2 free slots, APT-3, APT-4). S-5 has ACs for APT-3 and APT-4 only. Nothing tests the APT-2 free-slot partition, for example that only free slots are offered or bookable from the Book again page.

cites.quote: including free slots (APT-2), no overlapping appointments for the patient (APT-3)
then the booking is refused with "slot no longer available" (APT-4).

findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-5 AC: given the Book again page for doctor D today, an already-booked slot of D is not offered (or is refused) as today under APT-2.

findings.text: S-3 AC5 tests only the rejecting side of the 300-character limit (301 chars). No AC checks that exactly 300 characters is accepted, so an off-by-one tightening of the limit would pass.

cites.quote: enter a reason for visit with a 301st character (one past the 300-character limit)
The reason for visit keeps its 300-character limit.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC: a reason for visit of exactly 300 characters is accepted and booked from the Book again page.

findings.text: S-6 AC2 and AC3 end with 'behaves as today' and give no observable outcome, so they are hard to check objectively.

cites.quote: when staff choose doctor, patient, date and slot and book, then it behaves as today.

findings.suggested_fix: State the observable result, e.g. 'a Scheduled appointment is created for the chosen doctor, patient and slot'.

findings.text: The phrase 'the local side of midnight' in S-2 AC2 is unclear. The worked UTC conversion already makes the point.

cites.quote: so this is 19:00 UTC on 16 November, the local side of midnight

findings.suggested_fix: Reword to 'past midnight locally but still 16 November in UTC'.
